solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Sly hero follows start of cricket game

indicators.note: the opening letter of the word cricket is what this phrase selects

parts.note: Rambo is the action hero played by Sylvester 'Sly' Stallone

explanation.surface: A cunning champion takes his turn after the cricket match has begun.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sly' looks like an adjective meaning cunning, but it is Sylvester Stallone's nickname, so his hero is Rambo.
explanation.definitionFit: A word game in which players find rhymes for a given word, an old parlour pastime.

clue.text: Nurse's CV doesn't cover athlete's foot

indicators.note: doesn't cover says a letter is left out of the career record

parts.note: a CV is a summary of one's career

indicators.note: the foot of a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: A nurse's résumé omits a sporting injury.
explanation.walkthrough: 'athlete's foot' looks like the fungal infection, but it is just the last letter E.
explanation.definitionFit: A nurse, as a verb or noun, is someone who looks after the sick, a synonym.

clue.text: Disturbed remains in a plot

indicators.note: in says the remains are put inside the other pieces

parts.note: a bed is a plot of garden ground
ash is what remains after burning

explanation.surface: Someone is upset that human remains have been found in a plot.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling embarrassed and disconcerted, a sense of being disturbed or put out.

clue.text: Orange mob scattered, returning missile

indicators.note: scattered means the letters are dispersed and regrouped

explanation.surface: A crowd in orange disperses as something thrown flies back at them.
explanation.definitionFit: A curved Aboriginal throwing stick designed to come back to its thrower.

clue.text: Site of dome by youth centre and a poor lodging

indicators.note: lodging means the rearranged letters are given lodgings between the other two pieces

parts.note: by as in multiplication, three by four, is written with the times sign X

indicators.note: the central letter of the five-letter word youth is wanted
poor suggests the letters of and a are in bad shape and need rearranging

explanation.surface: A cheap hostel next to the youth club, standing near some domed building.
explanation.walkthrough: X and U (the centre of yoUth) house ANAD, which 'poor' makes from AND A.
explanation.definitionFit: In Coleridge's poem Kubla Khan decreed a stately pleasure-dome in this place, making it the dome's famous location.

clue.text: A party on service deck

parts.note: a do is a party
RN, the Royal Navy, is one of the armed services

explanation.surface: A party held on a ship's deck after a church service.
explanation.walkthrough: 'deck' looks like a ship's floor, but it is the verb, to decorate.
explanation.definitionFit: To deck something out is to decorate or beautify it.

clue.text: Very old, worked with son for instance

indicators.note: worked suggests letters are worked into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: An elderly man, still working alongside his son, for example.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer plus S is an anagram of INSTANCE. 'with' and 'for' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: Ancient means belonging to the distant past, extremely aged.

clue.text: Lower tone — felt piano intruding

indicators.note: intruding says the soft letter pushes into the felt word

parts.note: felt is used as carpet underlay
p is the musical abbreviation for piano, softly

explanation.surface: A musician softens the sound because felt pads are pressing into the piano.
explanation.definitionFit: To downplay something or act it with restraint is to lower its tone.

clue.text: The reason he was axed?

indicators.note: was axed says the word he is chopped out of the phrase before it

parts.note: taken as written, the pronoun's two letters

explanation.surface: Someone asks why a man lost his head, or his job.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove HE from THE REASON. Read whole, the clue also defines: betrayal of the crown was a classic reason for beheading.
explanation.definitionFit: Betraying one's sovereign was the crime for which traitors were beheaded, so it is the cause of the execution.

clue.text: Give up trick to potential winner, say

parts.note: to con someone is to trick them

indicators.note: say signals that the next word is only heard, spelt differently

parts.note: a seed in a tennis draw is a player ranked as a likely winner

explanation.surface: A card player gives away a trick to the person who might take the game.
explanation.walkthrough: The seed sound is spelt CEDE; 'to' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: To concede is to admit defeat or yield a point, which is to surrender it.

clue.text: East Germans ruin first snack

indicators.note: first says the ruin word comes before the other pieces

parts.note: to scotch a plan is to ruin it
G is German, doubled for the plural

explanation.surface: East Germans first wrecked something, then had a bite to eat.
explanation.definitionFit: A hard-boiled egg wrapped in sausage meat and breadcrumbs, a British picnic food.

clue.text: A Catholic had once represented senior cleric

parts.note: RC is the usual abbreviation for Roman Catholic

indicators.note: represented is read as re-presented, these letters set out again in a new order

explanation.surface: A churchman once stood in for a high-ranking clergyman.
explanation.walkthrough: A, RC and HADONCE are rearranged as one pool, signalled by 'represented'.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Anglican church this official ranks just below a bishop, overseeing clergy in a diocese division.

clue.text: People who do it are trained normally at the start

definitions.text: People who do it are trained normally at the start

indicators.note: trained suggests the three letters of are are drilled into a new order
only the first letter of normally is taken

explanation.surface: Workers in a job usually get some training when they begin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trained' rearranges ARE into EAR, then 'at the start' takes N from normally. People who do this work, the earners, are often trained when they start.
explanation.definitionFit: To receive pay for work is the activity done by wage-earners, which is what the clue's people do.

clue.text: Law's absolute in West Bank area

parts.note: Jude Law is the English actor, so Law's first name is Jude
A is the abbreviation for absolute, as in degrees absolute

explanation.surface: A legal principle that holds without exception in the West Bank.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Law' looks like the legal system, but it is the actor Jude Law.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient region of southern Palestine roughly covers the southern part of the modern West Bank.

clue.text: Stone me! He gets around a bit!

parts.note: jet is a black stone used in jewellery
the crossword's compiler refers to himself

explanation.surface: An exclamation of surprise at a man who travels widely.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stone me!' looks like an exclamation of surprise, but it is two pieces; 'me' is the compiler.
explanation.definitionFit: A wealthy person who flies around the world to fashionable places travels extensively.

clue.text: Grass could be a little taller, except for trail

indicators.note: could be says these letters may be rearranged into something else
except for says the letters of trail are left out of the mix

explanation.surface: A lawn might grow slightly higher, apart from the path through it.
explanation.walkthrough: Take the letters of TRAIL away from A LITTLE TALLER and rearrange what is left. 'Grass' is not lawn but an informer.
explanation.definitionFit: Grass is British slang for an informer, and a person who tells tales on others is just that.

clue.text: It's cheap to make alco pops roughly in 3 lines

indicators.note: in says these pieces sit inside the three lines

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for line, three times

indicators.note: pops suggests the letters burst apart and reform

parts.note: ca, circa, means roughly

explanation.surface: Making alcopops is a cheap business, roughly put.
explanation.walkthrough: '3' is not a cross-reference to the clue 3 but a number: three L's.
explanation.definitionFit: A telephone call within the same area was charged at a cheaper rate.

clue.text: Swimmer's first goal, winning tight finish comprehensively

indicators.note: winning means gaining or taking in, so one piece holds the other

parts.note: a beginner swimmer's first aim is to manage a length of the pool

indicators.note: the final letter of the word tight is taken

explanation.surface: A novice swimmer's first target achieved, winning a close race in style.
explanation.walkthrough: A LENGTH takes in T, the finish of tighT, after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: To discuss something in full detail, thoroughly and for a long time, is to treat it fully.

clue.text: Royal artist stops receiving messages

indicators.note: receiving says the stops word takes in the other pieces

parts.note: ends means stops
RA, Royal Academician, is a crossword artist

explanation.surface: A royal painter halts deliveries of messages.
explanation.definitionFit: Messages in the sense of errands, a British usage for shopping or trips to run.

clue.text: Relaxed but shy around both sexes

indicators.note: around says the shy word wraps itself about the other piece

parts.note: coy means bashful or shy
M and F are the abbreviations for male and female

explanation.surface: Someone at ease yet bashful in mixed company.
explanation.definitionFit: Comfortable and at ease, as in a cosy and relaxed setting, is the informal sense.

clue.text: Bill invested in footwear that's tending to change

indicators.note: invested in means put inside, as if clothed

parts.note: a mule is a backless slipper or shoe
a tab is a bill, as in pick up the tab

explanation.surface: Money spent on shoes that keep going in and out of fashion.
explanation.definitionFit: Liable to change or alter, a synonym phrase for changeable.

clue.text: Close down early, having trimmed margins

indicators.note: the words down early lose letters at both edges, leaving an inner run

explanation.surface: A shop shuts early after cutting its profit margins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Close' looks like a verb, shut down, but it is the adjective meaning nearby.
explanation.definitionFit: Close in the sense of nearby or not far off, an adjective synonym.

clue.text: Got rule in a mess, so made another one

indicators.note: in a mess says the letters are in disorder and must be sorted out

explanation.surface: Someone made a muddle of one rule, so drafted another.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one' refers back to 'rule', so 'another one' means another rule.
explanation.definitionFit: A regulation is an official rule, so it is another of what the clue has just mentioned.

clue.text: One's protected by ferocious horn

indicators.note: protected by says the first piece is shielded on both sides
ferocious suggests the letters are wild and need taming into order

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: An animal guarded by its fearsome horn.
explanation.walkthrough: I sits inside RHNO, made from HORN by 'ferocious'. Read whole, the clue defines the animal itself.
explanation.definitionFit: The large African or Asian beast is armed with a fearsome horn on its snout.

clue.text: They emerge from what's in pens, very big pens

definitions.text: They emerge from what's in pens, very big pens

indicators.note: pens as a verb means encloses, so the outsize letters fence in the other piece

parts.note: OS means outsize, very big
ink is what fills a fountain pen

explanation.surface: Something comes out of the ink in large fountain pens.
explanation.walkthrough: Read whole, what's in pig pens is pigs, and these are the noises they make.
explanation.definitionFit: Grunting noises made by pigs, which live in pens.

clue.text: Implement updated iTunes on laptop

indicators.note: an updated program has been reworked, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: the top of lap is its first letter, placed on the end

explanation.surface: Someone installs the latest version of Apple's music software on their computer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'laptop' is read as lap top, the top of lap, giving L.
explanation.definitionFit: A kitchen tool or other implement is a utensil, a noun synonym.

clue.text: Disney's kid? No, Roman's

parts.note: Bambi is the young deer in the Disney film
taken as written

explanation.surface: Asking whether a child is Disney's, then saying it belongs to an Italian.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is 'Roman's' kid: the Italian word for a baby, with 'kid' working in both halves.
explanation.definitionFit: In Italian this is the word for a small child, so it is what a Roman calls a kid.

clue.text: Don passes it and runs over small empty box

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for runs
O is the cricket abbreviation for an over

indicators.note: an empty box holds nothing, the round letter that looks like zero

parts.note: the box is British slang for television, TV

explanation.surface: A university don scrapes through, then reverses over a little cardboard box.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Don' is not a lecturer but the Russian river, on which the city of Rostov-on-Don stands.
explanation.definitionFit: The Russian city is formally named Rostov-on-Don because the river flows past it.

clue.text: Tool providers ban drink

indicators.note: ban says the drink is barred from the word for providers

parts.note: suppliers are those who provide goods
to sup is to drink

explanation.surface: Firms that provide tools prohibit alcohol.
explanation.definitionFit: A gripping hand tool with two hinged jaws, an example of a tool.
